field_semantics.addition: Relation addition is symmetric difference of term sets.
field_semantics.baseline_existing_method_label: The relation occurs in the 1+7+1 split and is labelled linearly equivalent; all true-labelled rows span the old-method baseline B.
field_semantics.linearly_equivalent_label: The frozen classifier labels the relation itself as expressible on a linearly equivalent cipher; quotient calculations must use the span of all true-labelled rows.
field_semantics.relation: A relation is the GF(2) incidence vector of its (input_mask, output_mask) terms.
